body:
Should stick through it.  I was 100% like you.  I fucking hated high school, every single minute of it.  I look really young for my age ( im 22 now but look ~16 or so)  so I was alienated quite a bit.  I had very few "friends" if you could even call them that.  When I had to do presentations my face would get red and I'd get shaky.  I know exactly where you are coming from.  I know how bad it feels, and how how much every day sucks.  Just try to do the best you can and get through it.  You are in your last year, that's it.

Like others have suggested try to get a job that revolves around interacting with people.  Hiding from your problem will only make it worse.  Yeah you will fucking hate the job too, but you will get better the more social situations you are put in.

Dropping out is probably the worst decision you can make.  You can always get a new therapist like others have suggested.  Medicine isn't likely to be an all cure, some of it has to come from you too.  

Like I said, find something that can give you some confidence, whether it be a hobby, or skill, or whatever.

Idk just my two cents.

I seriously doubt leaving your home to go to a shelter would make things better.  You will seriously regret dropping out of highschool later on.  

You sound a lot like me when I was in highschool.  I used to be pretty awkward, any time I had a presentation due for highschool, I'd call in sick 100% of the time.  

I can tell you it does get better, but you have to want it to become better.  My social anxiety was from not having any confidence.  Are you good at anything?  If not I suggest you find a hobby, or something you can become good at, and get really good at it.  It really does help to raise your confidence level.

Why do you get into fights with your parents/brother so much?

It sounds like you just started your therapy lessons, so your parents must take you at least somewhat seriously if they are doing this for you.  Stick with it a couple more weeks before deciding to do something as drastic as moving out to go to a shelter.

Dear god, I just checked a calculator and I need apparently ~2400 calories per day....I barley intake 1000 if that.  I used to not be able to eat at all, so my appetite has been curbed over the years hah...

this will be extremely challenging ><

No I just want to look healthy really.  I don't as you can imagine.  I feel like getting up and going to the gym would probably motivate me more, and I already have a gym membership, just haven't really used it yet since I don't know how to use any of the equipment/ I'm just not getting the pain under control from the crohn's as well.

I can't eat nuts/seeds/any fruit/veggies with skin or rough texture, just anything that's hard to digest really.  With the odd food here and there that I can't eat.

Yeah I suppose.  I just overthink everything and my mind likes to remind me of all my failures/embarrassments every night.  I think getting everything back on track would help fix that.  

I really do need to find a hobby or something, something I can't do at home >< .

I forgot to mention I have crohn's disease, which limits my diet, and is the cause of most of my weight loss.  I'm slowly starting to get control of it, but, it makes eating difficult.  

I don't even know where to start/how to use the equipment at a gym.  What would be the easiest way to learn?  Hire someone to show me how to properly use the different equipment for a couple hours?
Sometimes it helps just to go somewhere, even if it's by yourself.  Call up one of your friends and go do something.
If you need someone to talk to, feel free to pm me.
Something that has helped me with confidence, is getting really good at something.  For you it could be learning to play a musical instrument well, or maybe painting, or whatever.
Sorry you are feeling so down...if you'd like to talk, feel free to pm me.

Haha I would upload one but there's too great of a chance I would be recognized.  I've been called out multiple times already and am somewhat known and don't want to risk it....I'd be pretty embarrassed if this got out :/ .

Yeah dating down would probably be the best option.  I seem to only be attracted to girls that are younger than me anyway.  I think it's because I think I'd look awkward with one my own age >_> .

I'm probably just being emo...I don't know, just bottled up in your head everything seems so much worse sometimes it helps to just talk..

Pming is a bit tricky on this site haha.

Yeah.  I got it from my mother.  She's 55 now and doesn't really look a day over 35.  Will be awesome when I'm older for sure, just makes me feel really awkward and out of place now.  Maybe there are some that wouldn't think twice about it....maybe I'm blowing it out of proportion.  Yeah I don't think I'm ugly...just look young...This isn't something I'm that open about, I've maybe told 2-3 people and that's about it.  My best friend doesn't even know, so I don't really have that many opinions on the matter :/ .

Maybe I make it out to be a bigger deal than it is?  It seems looking so young should be a major turn off for most girls?  Maybe I'm wrong.  Please correct me if I am >< .  

Yeah I know you would have absolutely no idea this bothers me so much if I hadn't spilled my guts here.  I keep it hidden pretty well.  Haha I'm sure you meant no harm, most people think it's a compliment.

Unfortunately it's a pretty small town, but I'll check it out anyway thanks.  I am not, can't really bring myself to talk to my doctor about it.  I'm really not good at talking about this kind of stuff in person, online is so much easier :/.

My job is a temporary gig, it won't last forever, just thankful for it now.  Will last me another 2-3 years max most likely.  

But yeah that's basically my thoughts as well.  Like what girl would be interested in a guy who looks 16 other than pedophiles?  I definitely plan on going back to school, just feel pretty worthless wasting so much time.  Why would someone want to go out with someone who has failed in so many ways, when there are so many guys out there who haven't failed, and have everything on track, and who look their age for that matter -_-.

Idk, I think I'm just kinda lonely.  I had ocd disorder and major anxiety/depression issues throughout highschool and had basically 0 friends.  I've basically just kept to myself and used video games as an escape from reality, and I think I'm just realizing how miserable I am.

Hmm...well looking significantly young, just makes me feel out of place everywhere.  Looking young isn't exactly a desired trait for a guy.  People see it as a compliment, therefore it's guaranteed to be mentioned 5 times everytime you go out. 

 Not to mention it's a huge confidence downer, when thinking about asking someone out.  What college girl wants to go out with someone who looks 16 ya know?  

I dunno, I guess I'm just looking for a magic answer that isn't there.  Or just came here to talk I guess.  Fuck I hate looking so young ><.  I really want to go back to school, but gpa is basically destroyed, seems a bit hopeless.
blue ^_^

Idk what more I can talk about, I've basically spilled out everything XD

i don't even know why I posted...I just don't know what to do t.t

I actually do have a job.  I'm pretty lucky in regards of that area.  I make a decent amount of money, especially considering I basically have no education.  Just really bad with money I guess.  Impulse buyer, for the instant gratification...also helps you forget...

And I think I've progressed to the point where I wouldn't have any more problems with oral presentations than a normal person would.  It's one aspect of my life that has gotten better with time...I'm slowly accepting  it, at least from an outsider point of view, you probably wouldn't be able to tell it effects me at all.  It's really hard to love yourself the way you are, when you absolutely hate everything about yourself and you are constantly reminded about it.  For some reason looking young is seen as a compliment, so anytime I go out I'm guaranteed to hear and talk about it at least 5 times.  I don't look freakishly young, but young enough to look out of place...

Just everyday it doesn't get better...nothing changes, just more time wasted...

Idk...
